policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Show the onboarding coachmark. 1: Don't show the onboarding coachmark.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to cache pages that have been loaded.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't cache pages. 1: Do cache pages

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show the onboarding coachmark when the user invokes the Redaction panel.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Show the onboarding coachmark. 1: Don't show the onboarding coachmark.

policies.summary: Specifies whether or not to display the startup splash screen at every launch.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't display the startup splash screen. 1: Display the startup splash screen at every launch.

policies.summary: Toggles whether to show an alert when a user executes the Set Alternate Text dialog and there are no images missing alternate text.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Show alert. 1: Don't show alert.

policies.summary: Toggles on and off whether the end user license agreement appears.
Specifies whether to show "Get Started with Acrobat" on startup.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't show the Getting Started page. 1: Show the Getting Started page.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show a horizontal scrollbar when the viewing area is narrower than the width of the loaded document.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Disable the horizontal scrollbar. 1: Enable the horizontal scrollbar.

policies.summary: Toggles whether to show an alert when a user tries to attach a report if there is already a report attached.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Show alert. 1: Don't show alert.

policies.summary: Toggles whether to show an informative alert when a user executes the Set Alternate Text dialog.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Show alert. 1: Don't show alert.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show the skipped onboarding coachmark.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Disables the feature. 1: Enables the feature.

policies.summary: Toggles whether the splash screen appears on startup.
Indicates whether or not the application has started up and invoked the splash screen.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: The splash screen has not been invoked yet. 1: The splash screen has been invoked.

policies.summary: Records whether the application is operating in Trial Mode.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Not in trial mode 1: In trial mode

policies.summary: Specifies whether to invoke the new viewer onboarding tour when a PDF opens in the modern viewer the first time.
policies.details: Once the viewer onboarding tour displays, the app automatically resets this value to 0. This preference has no effect if AVGeneral/bEnableAv2 is 0. Possible values include: 0: Show the onboarding tour (not yet shown). 1: Don't show the onboarding tour (already shown or declined).

policies.summary: Specifies the number of seconds the standalone application stays in memory before it shuts down.
policies.details: Possible values include: 30 Any integer

policies.summary: Specifies whether to allow background downloading of resources the view thinks it needs to properly display the PDF.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't allow background downloading. 1: Do allow background downloading.

policies.summary: Specifies the number of seconds the browser-based application stays in memory before it shuts down.
policies.details: Possible values include: 30 Any integer

policies.summary: Open browser PDFs in Read Mode.
policies.details: Hides standard toolbars; compact menu appears on hover. Values: 0 = standard toolbars; 1 = Read Mode.

policies.summary: A preference used by the usage measurement feature to determine whether the previously set UsageMeasurement-related keys should be reset.
Specifies whether the collaboration executable should be invoked and run as a background process on startup.
policies.details: When enabled, AdobeCollabSync.exe runs on application startup. This process is used for features like shared reviews and forms data collection . Possible values include: 0: Start the process. 1: Don't start the process.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to enable Fast Web View by allowing display of the PDF before the entire file is downloaded.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't enable Fast Web View. 1: Enable Fast Web View.

policies.summary: Specifies the users choice
policies.details: When a user selects "Ask every time" and iFavoriteFilesAccessOption is set to 0, this new preference remembers the users choice for each file. Possible values include: Application generated.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show starred files in the recent files list.
policies.details: A starred file is somewhat similar to a "favorited" file. Note that the lockable version of this preference is named bFavoritesFeaturesLockDown . Possible values include: 0: Show starred files in the recent files list. 1: Don't show starred files in the recent files list.

policies.summary: Specifies what action to take when starring a file.
policies.details: A starred file is somewhat similar to a "favorited" file. Possible values include: 0: Show a dialog and ask whether to save or upload. This option also results in creating a new bFavoriteFilesRememberChoice . 1: Upload to Document Cloud 2: Save the file locally

policies.summary: Specifies whether the user logon credentials for the Tracker should be stored.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't store credentials. 1: Store credentials.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to turn of the "Updater has not been able to check for updates recently" dialog.
policies.details: Possible values include: 0: Don't turn off the dialog. 1: Do turn off the dialog.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show the Acrobat mobile app promotion and link in the Home banner.
policies.details: Disable and lock both the App Center and Home banner with bToggleDCAppCenter under FeatureLockDown. Possible values include: 0: Promote the mobile app. 1: Don't promote the mobile app.

policies.summary: Specifies whether to show the Adobe Scan mobile app promotion and link in the Home banner.
policies.details: Disable and lock both the App Center and Home banner with bToggleDCAppCenter under FeatureLockDown. Possible values include: 0: Promote the mobile app. 1: Don't promote the mobile app.
